To find the total volume of concrete needed for the continuous footing including 7% waste, we first calculate the exact volume of the footing in cubic feet:

- **Length:** $187\text{ ft}$
- **Width:** $2\text{ ft } 7\text{ in} = 2.5833\text{ ft}$
- **Depth:** $1\text{ ft } 2\text{ in} = 1.1667\text{ ft}$

$$\text{Volume} = 187\text{ ft} \times 2.5833\text{ ft} \times 1.1667\text{ ft} = 563.79\text{ cu ft}$$

Next, convert the volume to cubic yards by dividing by $27$:
$$\text{Volume in CY} = \frac{563.79}{27} = 20.88\text{ CY}$$

Add 7% for waste:
$$\text{Total with waste} = 20.88\text{ CY} \times 1.07 = 22.34\text{ CY}$$

FINAL: 22.34 CY
